basic_info.description: Welcome to Park 426, a spacious 1BD/1BA home in the heart of Mission Bay. This open floor plan residence overlooks a lush and serene courtyard, offering a peaceful retreat in the city. Hardwood floors lead into a beautifully appointed kitchen with premium Gaggenau appliances, including a five-burner gas cooktop, wall oven, and integrated refrigerator and dishwasher behind sleek wood paneling. One Mission Bay offers resort-style amenities: 24-hour lobby staff, heated outdoor pool, hot tub, lounge and dining areas, fire pit, cabanas, barbecues, and a large terrace for outdoor entertaining. Residents also enjoy a state-of-the-art fitness center, library, business center with private meeting rooms, and a reservable guest suite. Live surrounded by greenery and vibrant city life just steps from Arsicault Bakery, Flour + Water Pizzeria, and Gus Market. With easy access to public transit, freeways, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and scenic Mission Creek, this is the perfect blend of urban convenience and outdoor serenity.
